text: Opened PR #5410 (agent/v1-windows-reserved-device-names, base v1-development) fixing #5404: adds path_has_reserved_windows_device_name_component() (Windows-only, no-op on POSIX) to the same four files PR #5399 patched for trailing-dot/trailing-space aliasing -- workspace_agent_target_containment.cpp, workspace_agent_process_containment.cpp, workspace_agent_environment.cpp, workspace_agent_audit_sink.cpp -- closing the related gap where a component literally named CON/NUL/COM1/etc (with or without an extension) passed every existing check and would open the corresponding Win32 device object instead of a regular file/directory. New RQ-CF-AGENT-030 traceability row; regression coverage (NUL, con, COM1, lpt1.txt) added to all four test files. Verified locally that nothing regressed (5/5 pass), but since the new checks are Windows-only this doesn't exercise the new code path -- Windows Native Validation dispatch (run 33330701297) and an adversarial /code-review pass are both running now against commit 41a1b3da1/4e44233ef before merge. This branch, PR #5407 (physical_path_containment.cpp), and the planned #5402 pickup (external_process_policy.cpp) are deliberately on separate branches off v1-development with no file overlap, so all three can proceed in parallel.
